change_summary: Fixed MCP UI resource assembly so replacement tokens inside the built player bundle remain literal, and added a regression that parses the exact inline script delivered by readResource.
decisions: Use a String.replace callback to insert the built bundle literally; replacement-string metasequences such as $` and $& previously expanded into HTML inside JavaScript.

Read the UI resource through the MCP client in the integration test, assert the marker is gone and its inline script equals dist/player.js byte for byte, then parse that extracted script with node:vm.Script. The earlier metadata and substring assertions did not detect malformed delivered JavaScript.
tests: npm test passed 5/5 on 2026-10-04 with localhost socket access; the HTTP MCP integration test read the actual UI resource, found the complete bundle, and parsed the delivered inline script successfully.
git diff --check passed before the product commit.
ambiguities: The owner's blank ChatGPT UI was consistent with the reproduced prior candidate defect, but the deployed host version was not confirmed.
blockers: No connected ChatGPT host test was available to observe UI rendering or audible Play/Pause/resume and error behavior after this fix. Host CSP, persistence, and PiP outcomes remain as documented in README.md.
